# The Useful Media Co

> The Useful Media Co is a one-person media company in Chennai, India, run by Raja. It publishes The Useful Tech (the #1 Apple blog on Medium, 78,000+ followers, 3.39M views), and The Useful Life (books), makes apps (Wristkeeper for iPhone, Textlore for Mac) and sells digital products including Useful Studio.

Last updated: 2026-11-03

## Useful Studio

> Useful Studio is a Claude Code skill pack for Mac, made by The Useful Media Co. It turns 1 typed line into a finished, branded short video (launch film, reel, explainer or b-roll) as MP4 in 16:9 and 9:16. Price today: $79 one time, 20 licences left at $79, then $99. It rises after every 20 sales (ladder: $79, $99, $129, $149, $199). Runs on the buyer's own Claude plan. Studio Pro is $349. Needs a Mac on macOS 14 or later and Claude Code with a paid Claude plan. Videos run 15 to 90 seconds. It does not generate AI images or footage of people. It is independent and not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

- [Useful Studio](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/): Product page with pricing, 11 example videos, requirements and FAQ.
- [Useful Studio vs lemo-opuscar](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-lemo-opuscar/): Comparison with the free Claude Code skill that has 59 film styles.
- [Useful Studio vs Remotion](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-remotion/): Comparison with the React video framework.
- [Useful Studio vs HyperFrames](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-hyperframes/): Comparison with HeyGen's HTML to video framework.
- [Useful Studio vs Claude Motion](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-claude-motion/): Comparison with Anthropic's beta animation tool.
- [Explainer videos with Claude Code](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/explainer-videos-with-claude-code/): How to make a 60 to 90 second explainer.
- [Launch video for your app](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/launch-video-for-your-app/): How to make a 25 to 35 second app launch film.

## Apps

- [Textlore](https://textlore.app/): Mac app to search, browse and export your whole iMessage and WhatsApp history, with recommendations friends sent you and promises you made pulled out automatically. 14-day free trial, then $20 once for the next 15 licences, then $25, rising $5 every 20 sales up to $39.
- [Wristkeeper](https://theusefulmedia.com/wristkeeper/): iPhone app for analog watch collectors: collection, wear log and a daily watch pick. Free for 3 watches; Pro $24.99 a year with 14 days free, $3.99 a month or $59.99 once. On the App Store since 13 Nov 2026: https://apps.apple.com/app/wristkeeper-watch-collection/id6819904928
- [Watch cost per wear](https://theusefulmedia.com/wristkeeper/cost-per-wear/): Watch cost per wear is what you paid divided by the days you wore it, worked out by hand, in a spreadsheet, or with Wristkeeper.
- [The Useful Apps](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/): Directory of Mac and iPhone apps worth paying for, and where they cost least.
- [The Useful Apps, every app](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/llms-full.txt): Every app in the directory with a one-line description, price and devices, plus every best-of guide and its winner.
- [Best-of guides](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/best/): 39 guides naming the best Mac and iPhone app for each job, the best free pick and who should choose something else.

## The Useful Library

> The Useful Library is The Useful Life's site for using nonfiction books to fix real problems: habits, focus, money and mindset. Each book page says which chapters to read, skim or skip, and why. Each idea page compares what different books say and gives steps to try today.

- [The Useful Library](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/): Search nonfiction books by the problem you want to fix.
- [Mystery Book, the daily game](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/game/): Guess the day's nonfiction book from 6 clues.
- [Atomic Habits: which chapters to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/atomic-habits/): Read chapters 1, 2, 3, 5, 13 and 16; skim or skip the rest, with a reason for each.
- [The 2 minute rule](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/ideas/the-2-minute-rule/): James Clear's 2 minute rule (shrink a new habit) vs David Allen's (do any task under 2 minutes now).
- [I can't focus for long: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/cant-focus/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 different reasons your focus breaks, and 1 thing to try today from each: Deep Work, Indistractable and Digital Minimalism.
- [I overthink everything: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/overthinking/): 3 ways nonfiction books tackle overthinking, and 1 thing to try today from each: Meditations, The Obstacle Is the Way and Four Thousand Weeks.
- [I overspend every month: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/overspending/): 3 money books, 3 ways to stop overspending, and 1 thing to try today from each: I Will Teach You to Be Rich, The Psychology of Money and Your Money or Your Life.
- [Deep Work: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/deep-work/): Read the 4 rules, skim the rest. Part 1 argues for focus at length; Part 2 tells you how to do it.
- [Indistractable: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/indistractable/): Read parts 1, 2 and 4. They hold the whole method; the rest applies it to work, kids and relationships.
- [Digital Minimalism: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/digital-minimalism/): Read chapters 3, 4 and 6. The declutter plus what to fill the time with.
- [Meditations: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/meditations/): Start with Books 2, 4, 5 and 8. The other books repeat the same ideas in new words, which is the point, but not where to start.
- [The Obstacle Is the Way: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-obstacle-is-the-way/): Read Parts 1 and 2. They turn Stoicism into a method: see clearly, then act.
- [Four Thousand Weeks: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/four-thousand-weeks/): Read the introduction, chapters 1, 2, 4 and 7, and the 10 tools at the end. That's the whole argument plus what to do with it.
- [The Psychology of Money: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-psychology-of-money/): Read 7 of the 20 short chapters. They hold the ideas that change how you spend and save.
- [I Will Teach You to Be Rich: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/i-will-teach-you-to-be-rich/): Read chapters 4, 5 and 6 wherever you live. Much of the rest is built around US banks, cards and accounts.
- [Your Money or Your Life: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/your-money-or-your-life/): Do steps 2, 3, 4 and 8. They turn money into hours of your life, which changes how small buys feel.
- [The Power of Habit: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-power-of-habit/): Read chapters 1 to 5 and the appendix. The rest is about companies and social movements: good stories, less to use.
- [Tiny Habits: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/tiny-habits/): Read chapters 1, 3, 4 and 5. They hold the whole method; the rest grows it and applies it to bad habits and groups.
- [I start strong, then quit: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/start-strong-then-quit/): 3 habit books, 3 reasons a strong start fades, and 1 thing to try today from each: Tiny Habits, Atomic Habits and The Power of Habit.
- [The Useful Reading Challenge 2027](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/challenge/): 12 months, 12 problems, 1 nonfiction book a month with chapter verdicts, a tracker and a private Discord channel.
- [The Little Book of Common Sense Investing: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-little-book-of-common-sense-investing/): Read 6 of the 20 chapters. They make the whole case for low-cost index funds; the rest backs it up with more data. Chapters follow the 2017 10th anniversary edition.
- [Essentialism: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/essentialism/): Read 5 of the 21 chapters: the core idea, trade-offs, the 90 percent rule, saying no and cutting losses. The rest adds stories around them.
- [I don't know how to start investing: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/start-investing/): 3 investing books, 3 reasons people never start, and 1 thing to try today from each: The Little Book of Common Sense Investing, I Will Teach You to Be Rich and The Psychology of Money.
- [Mindset: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/mindset/): Read 3 of the 8 chapters: the 2 mindsets, how they change failure and effort, and how to change yours. The middle chapters apply the idea to sport, work, love and parenting. Chapters follow the updated edition.
- [Man's Search for Meaning: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/mans-search-for-meaning/): Read 3 of the 6 parts: Frankl's camp memoir, his short guide to logotherapy and the 1984 postscript. The book is short, so read them in order. Parts follow the 2006 Beacon Press edition.
- [Small setbacks ruin my week: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/small-setbacks/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 reasons a small setback spreads into your whole week, and 1 thing to try today from each: Mindset, The Obstacle Is the Way and Man's Search for Meaning.
- [Books](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/): Every book in the Library, sorted by area, with its verdict or fix.
- [Ideas](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/ideas/): Single ideas from nonfiction books, each with 1 thing to try today.
- Area hubs: [Habits](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/habits/), [Focus](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/focus/), [Money](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/money/), [Mindset](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/mindset/).
- [Problems](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/): Every problem page: 3 fixes from 3 nonfiction books each.
- [About the Library](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/about/): Who writes it (Raja, 70+ nonfiction books a year) and how verdicts are made.
